what: A command that starts the daemon prints two long lines before anything else (`blaze: starting the daemon (no socket activation is installed ...)`, `blaze: the daemon it started (pid ..) started: the database starts empty ...`) with eprintln, before the screen exists, so they stay in the scrollback above a region and wrap at 80 columns.
cost: none; they are the one thing of a cold start the screen does not own
cause: the connect path writes stderr itself
fix: hand them to the screen as events (a note under -v, the status row's words otherwise) once the connect path is settled
